arms.with: SigMap index strategy + 7-tool core MCP profile (the docs' setup for an agent that calls the tools)

method.selection: the task id(s) x027, x028, x029, x030, x031
method.passDefinition: hit@5 on the repository-relative paths the answer names

caveats: One agent, one model, one date. The result says nothing about another agent or model.
The questions ask where code lives, so this measures localisation, not edit or generation quality.
Pass is hit@5 on the paths the answer names (the retrieval corpora's own definition), not a human judgement.
Tasks are the first K by id per repo — a rule, not a random sample. N is small and one task is worth 1/N: read it as a band, not a point.
Token figures are per-request billing categories summed over the run. They are not the size of the context.
The SigMap arm adds SigMap's generated section to the system prompt, so its input and cache figures include that cost.
Cost is the agent's own account. Prompt caching makes it depend on run order; arms are interleaved and counterbalanced to spread that, not to remove it.
The self repo is excluded: its tree holds its own answer key and its own generated context.
Repetitions reuse the same tasks, so they measure consistency, not generalisation to other tasks.
The workload total is dominated by the largest tasks; the typical-task estimate gives every task equal weight. The two can disagree in sign on the same runs, and neither is a correction of the other.
A typical-task interval that includes zero (†) is inside the noise: the runs cannot tell that change from none.

Total tokens is a derived, unweighted sum of the four billing categories, so a cache read counts like a fresh token. Read Cost for the priced view: a token change and a cost change can differ in sign.

Direct Messages API agent (scripts/lib/agent-ab-api.mjs), not Claude Code: a short neutral system prompt (about 150 tokens) and four read-only tools, so the prefix each turn re-reads is far smaller than Claude Code's and SigMap's per-turn addition is a larger share of a turn. Cost is computed from the usage the API reports and a price table (the Console's usage page is the authority), with 5-minute prompt caching. Not comparable cell by cell with Claude Code runs.
